sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: How should you grip a racket for a forehand strike?
options: A) Like you are shaking hands with it
questions.answer: A) Like you are shaking hands with it

questions.question_text: In Kho-Kho, how do the seated players face?
options: A) All face the same direction
D) All face outward in a circle

questions.question_text: Jumping jacks are a good exercise for:
Stretching your legs before a running game helps to:
options: B) Prevent muscle cramps and pulls
questions.answer: B) Prevent muscle cramps and pulls

questions.question_text: Accepting a loss gracefully is called:
When swinging a racket, you should ensure:
options: B) You have safe space around you
D) You aim for someone's head
questions.answer: B) You have safe space around you

questions.question_text: The active chaser in Kho-Kho can pass their turn by doing what?
options: B) Tapping a seated teammate's back and saying 'Kho'
questions.answer: B) Tapping a seated teammate's back and saying 'Kho'

questions.question_text: To strike a ball well, your eyes must be focused on:
Which of these is NOT part of a good warm-up?

options: B) Keeping a safe distance from other players
C) Standing on top of someone
questions.answer: B) Keeping a safe distance from other players

questions.question_text: Describe the 'shake hands' grip used for holding a racket.
questions.answer: Hold the racket handle just like you are reaching out to shake hands with someone; wrap your fingers around it firmly.

questions.question_text: What does giving a 'Kho' do in the game of Kho-Kho?
questions.answer: It transfers the role of the active chaser to the seated teammate, allowing them to chase the runners.

questions.question_text: Why should we stretch our muscles during a warm-up?
questions.answer: Stretching makes muscles flexible, increases blood flow, and prepares the body to move quickly without getting injured.

questions.question_text: How can you show good sportsmanship if your team loses?
questions.answer: Do not complain or cry; instead, smile, say 'good game' to the winning team, and shake their hands.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to maintain safe spacing when doing racket drills?
questions.answer: Safe spacing ensures that you do not accidentally hit another student with your racket while swinging.

sections.section_name: Section C - Sports Mechanics & Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks: In Kho-Kho, the active _______ cannot change directions once they start running down the line, but the _______ can run anywhere.
Match the warm-up exercise to the body part it helps most: 1) Arm circles, 2) High knees. Options: A) Legs/Hips, B) Shoulders/Arms.
questions.answer: 1 matches with B, 2 matches with A

questions.question_text: A student in your class complains of sore muscles because they skipped the warm-up to start playing immediately. What advice would you give them for the next class?
questions.answer: I would advise them that warming up is like starting a car engine; it gets the body ready. Next time, they must join the warm-up stretches to prevent pain and injuries.

questions.question_text: Create a fun game using a racket and a balloon to practice hand-eye coordination safely indoors.
questions.answer: The game is 'Keep it Up!'. Each student gets a racket and a balloon. They must gently tap the balloon upward with the racket, trying to see how many times they can hit it without it touching the ground.
